newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SIMEX Brent quiet, but NYMEX firmer on Iraq.
newsitem.headline: SIMEX Brent quiet, but NYMEX firmer on Iraq.

text.p: August Brent crude futures in Asia were untraded at midday and hardly talked as players waited for London to start trading to get their cue, brokers said on Monday
August was bid at $18.15 per barrel on SIMEX after London settled at $18.18 for a gain of 33 cents on the day.
Brokers said Iraq comments that exports would not resume as soon as had been expected would support prices.

Iraq's chief United Nations negotiator, Abdul Amir al-Anbari, said in Switzerland during the weekend that exports might resume in August so long as Baghdad's distribution plan for medicine and food was approved during July by the U.N..
August NYMEX crude on ACCESS was last traded at $19.60, up 14 cents from New York's close.
